annotations.title: Forward an app's events to a URL

description: Add a destination to an existing app: new events are forwarded to this URL, with retries, within about a minute, and the app's other destinations stay as they are. Adding a URL the app already has changes nothing. Returns the destination's signing secret once, for verifying the AnyHook-Signature header on the receiving server.

api_key.description: API key (ahk_live_...) from anyhook_quickstart. Only needed over HTTP when no Authorization header is set; ignored over stdio.

appSlug.description: The app whose events should be forwarded.

url.description: Public https URL that receives each event as a POST.

name: anyhook_destination_add
title: Forward an app's events to a URL
